# SPP North-South hub spread: # Transcribed 2026-09-06 by lane SPP-12 from the ASOM editions in ../transcriptions/.
# Sign convention: spread = SOUTH hub - NORTH hub. Positive = South dearer (the normal
# pattern; the MMU attributes it to gas in the south vs coal/nuclear/wind in the north).
# THIS IS NOT the hourly per-hub series card P1/P7 asked for. It is an ANNUAL MEAN the
# MMU states in prose plus its on-peak DA table. It CAN rank years by spread; it CANNOT
# give mean/p90 of |North-South| over 8760 hours -- that needs the blocked portal LMP
